title: Scalar-mean curvature rigidity of a strictly log-concave spherical warped band for a nonzero-degree Lipschitz spin map
source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
